webuiSettings.description: Where Rooks answers, how to open it from your phone, and whether that is safe.
webuiSettings.loadError: Could not read the network facts from the daemon.
webuiSettings.forbidden: Reading this machine's network configuration requires an administrator account.
webuiSettings.servedExternally: Served outside the daemon, through a reverse proxy
webuiSettings.remoteReadyHint: Open it from any device signed into your tailnet.
webuiSettings.securityNoAccount: No account yet: create one before opening access.
webuiSettings.appSecure: This address is a secure context: your browser can install Rooks.
webuiSettings.appInsecure: This address is not a secure context (plain HTTP): no install. Use the HTTPS tailnet address.
webuiSettings.setupIntro: Tailscale links your devices in a private network with an HTTPS address, without opening any port.
webuiSettings.step1Title: Install Tailscale on the machine hosting Rooks ({os})
webuiSettings.step1NotPhone: Not on the device you connect from: this machine is the one that must join.
webuiSettings.step1MacHint: Or install the Tailscale app from the Mac App Store, then sign in.
webuiSettings.step1Unknown: No install command is known for this machine: use the download page.
webuiSettings.step2Unreadable: Tailscale answered something Rooks cannot read: {detail}
webuiSettings.step3Replace: A handler already exists (see details): running the command replaces it.
webuiSettings.step4Body: Install the Tailscale app, sign in with the same account, then open:
webuiSettings.step4NoAddress: Install the Tailscale app, sign in with the same account, then open this machine's tailnet address.
webuiSettings.addressesHint: They answer only if Rooks listens beyond the loopback, which it does not by default.
webuiSettings.serveHint: The target must reach the interface, directly or through its reverse proxy.
webuiSettings.tlsProxyOn: Secure: HTTPS ends at a reverse proxy.
webuiSettings.tlsProxyOff: Not forced Secure. Turn daemon.behindTlsProxy on behind an HTTPS proxy.
webuiSettings.trustedProxiesNone: No trusted proxy: the audit log records the direct peer.
webuiSettings.rule1: Never publish a port straight onto a public interface: keep the loopback and put Tailscale Serve or a proxy in front.
webuiSettings.rule2: Create the accounts before opening access, and never set daemon.auth to off.
webuiSettings.rule3: Every device on your tailnet reaches Rooks: remove the ones you no longer use.
webuiSettings.editHint: These values are read here and changed in rooks.config.json or their own settings.
